items.title: Linux CUPS Vulnerability Let Attackers Remote DoS and Bypass Authentication
items.description: Two critical vulnerabilities have been discovered in the Linux Common Unix Printing System (CUPS), exposing millions of systems to remote denial-of-service attacks and authentication bypass exploits. The vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2025-58364 and CVE-2025-58060, affect the core printing infrastructure used across virtually all Linux distributions and pose significant risks to network…

items.title: BitlockMove Tool Enables Lateral Movement via Bitlocker DCOM & COM Hijacking
items.description: A new proof-of-concept (PoC) tool named BitlockMove demonstrates a novel lateral movement technique that leverages BitLocker’s Distributed Component Object Model (DCOM) interfaces and COM hijacking.
